  },
  "schema": [
    [
      "index",
      "activity_by_project",
      "activity",
      "CREATE INDEX activity_by_project ON activity(project, seq)"
    ],
    [
      "index",
      "deliveries_unread",
      "deliveries",
      "CREATE INDEX deliveries_unread\n  ON deliveries(project, recipient_id, read_at)"
    ],
    [
      "index",
      "delivery_claims_expiry",
      "delivery_claims",
      "CREATE INDEX delivery_claims_expiry\n  ON delivery_claims(project, recipient_id, expires_at)"
    ],
    [
      "index",
      "graph_attempts_by_pool",
      "graph_attempts",
      "CREATE INDEX graph_attempts_by_pool ON graph_attempts(adapter, model, account, holds_slot)"
    ],
    [
      "index",
      "messages_by_conversation",
      "messages",
      "CREATE INDEX messages_by_conversation\n  ON messages(project, conversation_id, created_at)"
    ],
    [
      "index",
      "work_claims_active",
      "work_claims",
      "CREATE INDEX work_claims_active ON work_claims(project, expires_at, released_at)"
    ],
    [
      "table",
      "activity",
      "activity",
      "CREATE TABLE activity (\n  seq      INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n  project  TEXT NOT NULL,\n  agent_id TEXT NOT NULL,\n  at       INTEGER NOT NULL,\n  kind     TEXT NOT NULL,\n  detail   TEXT NOT NULL\n)"
    ],
    [
      "table",
      "agents",
      "agents",
      "CREATE TABLE agents (\n  project    TEXT NOT NULL,\n  agent_id   TEXT NOT NULL,\n  provider   TEXT NOT NULL,\n  first_seen INTEGER NOT NULL,\n  last_seen  INTEGER NOT NULL,\n  PRIMARY KEY (project, agent_id)\n)"
    ],
    [
      "table",
      "deliveries",
      "deliveries",
      "CREATE TABLE deliveries (\n  message_id   TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES messages(message_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n  project      TEXT NOT NULL,\n  recipient_id TEXT NOT NULL,\n  read_at      INTEGER,\n  PRIMARY KEY (message_id, recipient_id)\n)"
    ],
    [
      "table",
      "delivery_claims",
      "delivery_claims",
      "CREATE TABLE delivery_claims (\n  message_id   TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES messages(message_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n  project      TEXT NOT NULL,\n  recipient_id TEXT NOT NULL,\n  claim_id     TEXT NOT NULL,\n  claimed_at   INTEGER NOT NULL,\n  expires_at   INTEGER NOT NULL,\n  PRIMARY KEY (message_id, recipient_id)\n)"
    ],
    [
      "table",
      "graph_attempts",
      "graph_attempts",
      "CREATE TABLE graph_attempts (\n  project        TEXT NOT NULL,\n  graph_id       TEXT NOT NULL,\n  node_id        TEXT NOT NULL,\n  revision       INTEGER NOT NULL,\n  attempt        INTEGER NOT NULL,\n  restart        INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,\n  state          TEXT NOT NULL,\n  task_id        TEXT NOT NULL,\n  run_id         TEXT,\n  run_dir        TEXT,\n  input_attempts TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',\n  adapter        TEXT NOT NULL,\n  model          TEXT NOT NULL,\n  account        TEXT NOT NULL,\n  holds_slot     INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,\n  kept           INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,\n  gate_procs     TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',\n  outcome        TEXT,\n  updated_at     INTEGER NOT NULL,\n  PRIMARY KEY (project, graph_id, node_id, revision, attempt, restart)\n)"
    ],
    [
      "table",
      "graph_revisions",
      "graph_revisions",
      "CREATE TABLE graph_revisions (\n  project       TEXT NOT NULL,\n  graph_id      TEXT NOT NULL,\n  revision      INTEGER NOT NULL,\n  document_json TEXT NOT NULL,\n  plan_json     TEXT,\n  spec_hash     TEXT,\n  origin        TEXT,\n  created_at    INTEGER NOT NULL,\n  PRIMARY KEY (project, graph_id, revision)\n)"
    ],
    [
      "table",
      "graph_worktree_reservations",
      "graph_worktree_reservations",
      "CREATE TABLE graph_worktree_reservations (\n  realpath   TEXT PRIMARY KEY,\n  project    TEXT NOT NULL,\n  graph_id   TEXT NOT NULL,\n  node_id    TEXT NOT NULL,\n  revision   INTEGER NOT NULL,\n  attempt    INTEGER NOT NULL,\n  token      TEXT NOT NULL,\n  created_at INTEGER NOT NULL\n)"
    ],
    [
      "table",
      "graphs",
      "graphs",
      "CREATE TABLE graphs (\n  project          TEXT NOT NULL,\n  graph_id         TEXT NOT NULL,\n  revision         INTEGER NOT NULL,\n  state            TEXT NOT NULL,\n  owner_pid        INTEGER,\n  owner_started    TEXT,\n  chair_identity   TEXT NOT NULL,\n  cancel_requested INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,\n  created_at       INTEGER NOT NULL,\n  updated_at       INTEGER NOT NULL,\n  PRIMARY KEY (project, graph_id)\n)"
    ],
    [
      "table",
      "landing_leases",
      "landing_leases",
      "CREATE TABLE landing_leases (\n  project TEXT PRIMARY KEY,\n  holder TEXT NOT NULL,\n  generation INTEGER NOT NULL,\n  expected_sha TEXT NOT NULL,\n  expires_at INTEGER NOT NULL,\n  pushing_until INTEGER,\n  released_at INTEGER\n)"
    ],
    [
      "table",
      "messages",
      "messages",
      "CREATE TABLE messages (\n  message_id      TEXT PRIMARY KEY,\n  project         TEXT NOT NULL,\n  sender_id       TEXT NOT NULL,\n  body            TEXT NOT NULL,\n  kind            TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'note',\n  conversation_id TEXT NOT NULL,\n  reply_to        TEXT REFERENCES messages(message_id),\n  task_id         TEXT,\n  output_path     TEXT,\n  created_at      INTEGER NOT NULL\n)"
    ],
    [
      "table",
      "run_observations",
      "run_observations",
      "CREATE TABLE run_observations (\n  project     TEXT NOT NULL,\n  recipient_id TEXT NOT NULL,\n  run_id      TEXT NOT NULL,\n  task_id     TEXT NOT NULL,\n  attempt     INTEGER NOT NULL,\n  PRIMARY KEY(project, recipient_id, run_id, task_id)\n)"
    ],
    [
      "table",
      "sessions",
      "sessions",
      "CREATE TABLE sessions (\n  project             TEXT NOT NULL,\n  name                TEXT NOT NULL,\n  adapter             TEXT,\n  provider_session_id TEXT,\n  run_id              TEXT,\n  task_id             TEXT,\n  attempt             INTEGER,\n  result_path         TEXT,\n  turn_claim          TEXT NOT NULL,\n  turn_kind           TEXT NOT NULL,\n  turn_run_id         TEXT,\n  turn_task_id        TEXT,\n  turn_attempt        INTEGER,\n  turn_status         TEXT,\n  turn_pid            INTEGER,\n  created_by          TEXT NOT NULL,\n  updated_by          TEXT NOT NULL,\n  created_at          INTEGER NOT NULL,\n  updated_at          INTEGER NOT NULL,\n  PRIMARY KEY (project, name)\n)"
    ],
    [
      "table",
      "sqlite_sequence",
      "sqlite_sequence",
      "CREATE TABLE sqlite_sequence(name,seq)"
    ],
    [
      "table",
      "task_dependencies",
      "task_dependencies",
      "CREATE TABLE task_dependencies (\n  project    TEXT NOT NULL,\n  task_id    TEXT NOT NULL,\n  depends_on TEXT NOT NULL,\n  PRIMARY KEY (project, task_id, depends_on)\n)"
    ],
    [
      "table",
      "tasks",
      "tasks",
      "CREATE TABLE tasks (\n  project    TEXT NOT NULL,\n  task_id    TEXT NOT NULL,\n  objective  TEXT NOT NULL,\n  owner_id   TEXT,\n  state      TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'open',\n  created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,\n  updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL,\n  PRIMARY KEY (project, task_id)\n)"
    ],
    [
      "table",
      "team_members",
      "team_members",
      "CREATE TABLE team_members (\n  project  TEXT NOT NULL,\n  team_id  TEXT NOT NULL,\n  agent_id TEXT NOT NULL,\n  PRIMARY KEY (project, team_id, agent_id)\n)"
    ],
    [
      "table",
      "teams",
      "teams",
      "CREATE TABLE teams (\n  project    TEXT NOT NULL,\n  team_id    TEXT NOT NULL,\n  created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,\n  PRIMARY KEY (project, team_id)\n)"
    ],
    [
      "table",
      "work_claims",
      "work_claims",
      "CREATE TABLE work_claims (\n  generation INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n  id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,\n  project TEXT NOT NULL,\n  holder TEXT NOT NULL,\n  issue TEXT,\n  paths TEXT NOT NULL,\n  expires_at INTEGER NOT NULL,\n  released_at INTEGER\n)"
    ]
  ]
}
